title: Add SceneObject/interact method types and handler
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Add SceneObject/interact method types and handler
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L1978ff: "`SceneObject/interact` submits one or more interactions ... It works over HTTP and, as a `Request`, over the JMAP WebSocket"; args `accountId`, `interactions` (Id[SceneInteraction]: regionId, objectId, action, data); response `accountId`, `accepted` (Id[]|null), `notAccepted` (Id[SetError]|null); SetErrors notFound / forbidden (no active avatar or interactable:false) / rateLimit / invalidProperties.
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/lib.rs:186-189; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/ephemeral.rs:252-268; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/event.rs:114
Now: No SceneObject/interact anywhere: no SceneInteraction or args/response types in scene-types, no handler, and nothing registered in register (lib.rs only has SceneObject/get|changes|set|query). Interactions exist only as the WebSocket frame, checked by validate_interaction.
Change: Add SceneInteraction and the SceneObjectInteract args/response types to scene-types. Add handle_scene_object_interact to scene-server, reusing the validate_interaction checks: region access gives notFound, the visibility contract gives notFound, no active avatar or interactable:false gives forbidden, a malformed entry gives invalidProperties, and an optional rateLimit. Register "SceneObject/interact". Give the transport a hook to emit a SceneInteractionEvent for each accepted id.
